items.title: Gräfenberger Ritter Ritt
items.text: You completed the Gräfenberger Ritter Ritt! This moderate, circular mountain biking route was 11.5 km long, with 193 m of climbing. You started near Gräfenbergerhüll and passed the Turmuhrenmuseum Rammensee. Well done!

items.title: Hildpolds Höhenflug
items.text: You completed Hildpolds Höhenflug! This 15.9 km circular route, starting near Kemmathen, offered a moderate challenge. You conquered 326 m of climbing, reaching a highest point of 576 m. Well done on finishing this mountain biking adventure!

items.title: Großer Rundwanderweg Gmund
items.text: You completed the Großer Rundwanderweg Gmund, a circular route of 12.1 km. You climbed 221 m on this moderate trail that started near Gmund am Tegernsee. You passed the Jagerhaus, Vertriebene, and Floriansbrunnen.

items.title: Erzweg, Etappe 10: Theuern - Heimhof
items.text: You completed the difficult Erzweg, Etappe 10: Theuern - Heimhof! You hiked 19.6 km one way, with 347 m of climbing. You passed Kultur-Schloß Theuern, Burg Heimhof, and Industrie- und Bergbaumuseum.

items.title: Trimm-Dich-Pfad
items.text: You completed the Trimm-Dich-Pfad! You journeyed 1.5 km on this easy, one-way route, gaining 11 m of elevation. This linear route, starting near Untergartelshausen, offered a pleasant experience.

items.title: DAV-Rundweg (Grünring)
items.text: You completed the DAV-Rundweg (Grünring)! You hiked the entire 3.0 km circular route, climbing 90 m. You successfully navigated this easy trail near Neuöd, passing the Angfeldhütte. Well done.

items.title: Weitwanderweg Ursprungweg
items.text: You completed the difficult Weitwanderweg Ursprungweg! This one-way route, starting near Wörnsmühl, covered 25.2 km and included 328 m of climbing. You followed part of the Leitzach and passed Schmerzhafte Mittergottes.

items.title: Bauernhof Roas
items.text: You completed the Bauernhof Roas, a moderate, one-way route of 24.1 km with 423 m of climbing. You started near Agatharied and followed the Schlierach, passing the Kriegerdenkmal.

items.title: Tour de Taubenberg
items.text: You completed the 25.2 km one-way Tour de Taubenberg, a moderate cycling route that started near Oberwarngau. You conquered 315 m of climbing, passing St. Johann Baptist and Wallfahrtskirche Allerheiligen along the way.

items.title: Bike2Hike
items.text: You completed the Bike2Hike route! This easy, one-way route, 13.8 km long with 183 m of climbing, took you from Miesbach. You passed the lake Schliersee and followed the Schlierach.

items.title: Alpiner Premiumwanderweg Spitzing Panorama
items.text: You completed the difficult circular route, Alpiner Premiumwanderweg Spitzing Panorama! You hiked 7.8 km and climbed 697 m near Spitzingsee. Along the way, you passed the Bodenschneidhaus and enjoyed the Suttenstein viewpoint.

items.title: Outdoor Fitness- und Bewegungspfad
items.text: You completed the Outdoor Fitness- und Bewegungspfad! This easy, circular route, starting near Hohenschwärz, covered 1.7 km with 28 m of climbing. Well done!

items.title: Trans Bayerwald Südroute Etappe 1
items.text: You completed the very demanding Trans Bayerwald Südroute Etappe 1! You rode 48.2 km, climbing 1,003 m on this one-way route that started near Rötz. You passed the Waldvereinshütte and saw the Stadtturm viewpoint and Schloß Voithenberg.

items.title: Trans Bayerwald Südroute Etappe 2
items.text: You completed the very demanding one-way route, Trans Bayerwald Südroute Etappe 2! You rode 36.2 km with 823 m of climbing, starting near Rötz. Along the way, you passed the lake Eixendorfer Stausee and saw Schwarzenburg.

items.title: TrimmDich-Pfad Petershöhe
items.text: You completed the TrimmDich-Pfad Petershöhe! You covered 1.3 km on this circular route, which started near Unterasbach. You handled the easy difficulty and climbed 8 m. Well done!

items.title: Kienbergl-Runde
items.text: You completed the Kienbergl-Runde! You hiked this 7.1 km circular route, gaining 118 m in climbing. This easy trail started near Inzell, passed the lake Zwingsee, and went by St. Barbara. Well done!

items.title: Betzengravel light
items.text: You completed the moderate, one-way route, Betzengravel light! You rode 19.4 km near Betzenstein, climbing 206 m. You passed Burg Betzenstein, Pflegamtsschloss, and Bayreuther Tor.

items.title: Erlkam Runde
items.text: You completed the Erlkam Runde! This easy, one-way route covered 5.8 km with 23 m of climbing, starting near Holzkirchen. You journeyed past a playground and found refreshment at Föchinger Hof.

items.title: Marktlauf-Runde
items.text: You completed the Marktlauf-Runde! You ran the 7.4 km one-way route, starting near Holzkirchen. You tackled 104 m of climbing on this moderate route, passing the Batusa Stüberl and a playground along the way.

items.title: Kidsrunde Buchwald
items.text: You completed the Kidsrunde Buchwald, a moderate, one-way route. You rode 7.7 km and climbed 132 m. This route started near Hohenschwärz.

items.title: Berbling - Heinrichsdorf
items.text: You completed the easy, one-way Berbling - Heinrichsdorf route! You cycled 3.9 km with 52 m of climbing, starting near Dettendorf. Along the way, you passed Hofkapelle, Heilig-Kreuz-Kirche, and a playground.

items.title: Ellbach - Isar
items.text: You completed the easy, one-way route, Ellbach - Isar! You cycled 6.2 km, climbing 22 m. You started near Ellbach and passed the lake Isar-Stausee Tölz.

items.title: Der Passamani Rundwanderweg auf dem Karwendel
items.text: You completed Der Passamani Rundwanderweg auf dem Karwendel! This circular hiking trail, starting near Mittenwald, covered 1.0 km with 58 m of climbing. You navigated its moderate difficulty, passing the Natur-Informationszentrum Bergwelt Karwendel.

items.title: Bienen-Erlebnispfad
items.text: You completed the easy Bienen-Erlebnispfad, a 1.1 km circular route with 18 m of climbing. This route started near Seeg and took you past Heimatmuseum Seeg and Erlebnisimkerei.

items.title: Abenteuer-Familien-Rundweg
items.text: You completed the Abenteuer-Familien-Rundweg, an easy circular route near Stein. You hiked 3.6 km and climbed 36 m, passing the Großer Weiher and the Heimatmuseum Stein.

items.title: 520 Gmund - Bad Wiessee
items.text: You completed the 520 Gmund - Bad Wiessee route! You hiked 5.7 km on this one-way trail, climbing 154 m. This moderate route started near Gmund am Tegernsee and took you past Lake Tegernsee and Jagerhaus.

items.title: Rund um die Reuterwanne
items.text: You completed the circular route "Rund um die Reuterwanne"! You hiked 7.4 km and climbed 329 m on this easy trail. You started near Jungholz and passed the Buronhütte.

items.title: Bayerniederhofen - Trauchgau (über Buching)
items.text: You completed the easy, one-way route "Bayerniederhofen - Trauchgau (über Buching)". You cycled 4.5 km with 37 m of climbing. The route started near Bayerniederhofen and passed by the Dorfmuseum.

items.title: Rieden - Wanderparkplatz Wildstand
items.text: You completed the easy, one-way route "Rieden - Wanderparkplatz Wildstand." You cycled 4.8 km with 127 m of climbing, starting near Rieden am Forggensee. You passed the lake Faulensee and Zu den heiligen fünf Wunden.

items.title: Auerbergland
items.text: You completed the difficult one-way route, Auerbergland! You cycled 63.2 km, climbing 692 m, starting near Rettenbach. Along the way, you passed the lakes Dietringer Toteisloch, Forggensee and Lechsee, and enjoyed the Alpenpanorama viewpoint.

items.title: Sulzschneider Forst - Roßhaupten
items.text: You completed the Sulzschneider Forst - Roßhaupten route! You cycled the 5.9 km one-way route, with 90 m of climbing. This easy route started near Steinbach and took you past the Dorfmuseum.

items.title: Waldhaus - Rieder
items.text: You completed the Waldhaus - Rieder route! This easy, one-way route near Roßhaupten covered 3.2 km and included 26 m of climbing. You passed the lake Eggelesee and a playground on your journey.

items.title: Naturbiken Hopferwald-Senkele-Runde
items.text: You completed the difficult Naturbiken Hopferwald-Senkele-Runde! You rode 23.2 km and climbed 570 m on this one-way route that started near Roßhaupten. You passed the summit of Faulenberg and Faulensee.

items.title: Naturbiken Weiher- und Burgenrunde
items.text: You completed the difficult circular route, Naturbiken Weiher- und Burgenrunde! You rode 30.4 km near Seeg, climbing 503 m. You passed the lakes Schwaltenweiher, Schweinegger Schlossweiher, and Kögelweiher.

items.title: Trimm-Dich-Pfad Kaufbeuren Nord
items.text: You completed the Trimm-Dich-Pfad Kaufbeuren Nord! This circular route, starting near Kaufbeuren, was 2.2 km long with 44 m of climbing. You successfully navigated this easy route.

items.title: Rund um die Schweppermannsburg
items.text: You completed the easy cycling route, Rund um die Schweppermannsburg! You cycled 20.3 km with 198 m of climbing on this circular route that started near Kastl. You passed the Schweppermannsburg and Heimatmuseum Kastl.

items.title: Lachen - Dederles
items.text: You completed the easy, one-way route "Lachen - Dederles"! You cycled 4.1 km with 28 m of climbing. Starting near Schneidbach, you passed the lake Attlesee and St. Magnus. Well done!

items.title: Von Hütte zu Hütte rund um den Edelsberg
items.text: You completed the circular route "Von Hütte zu Hütte rund um den Edelsberg"! You hiked 12.0 km with 757 m of climbing on this moderate trail. You passed the huts Sportheim Böck, Kappeler Alp, and Hündleskopfhütte, and enjoyed the viewpoint Bergpanorama.

items.title: Naturbiken Grüntenseerunde
items.text: You completed the difficult Naturbiken Grüntenseerunde! This circular route, 22.5 km long with 625 m of climbing, started near Haslach. You passed the Grüntensee and enjoyed the viewpoint Stele 8.

items.title: Etappe 1 der Wiesengänger Route der Wandertrilogie Allgäu
items.text: You completed Etappe 1 der Wiesengänger Route der Wandertrilogie Allgäu! You hiked 26.8 km with 386 m of climbing on this difficult, one-way route that started near Marktoberdorf. You passed a viewpoint on your journey.

items.title: Emmentaler Radweg (Querachse Schwaltenweiher–Seeg)
items.text: You completed the Emmentaler Radweg (Querachse Schwaltenweiher–Seeg)! You cycled the 3.3 km one-way route with 35 m of climbing. This easy route started near Rückholz and passed the Schwaltenweiher. Well done!

items.title: Englmarer Fitness Runde
items.text: You completed the Englmarer Fitness Runde! You tackled 26 m of climbing over 1.7 km on this easy, circular route that started near Sankt Englmar. Well done!

items.title: Pfronten - Staatsgrenze
items.text: You completed the easy, one-way route "Pfronten - Staatsgrenze"! You cycled 6.4 km with 130 m of climbing. This route started near Röfleuten and followed the Vils.

items.title: Brennatsteig
items.text: You completed the Brennatsteig, a one-way route near Inzell. You hiked 1.4 km and ascended 245 m on this moderate trail, reaching the summit of Kleines Kienbergl (Kreuzspitz).

items.title: MTB 92 Inzell Dorfrunde
items.text: You completed the moderate MTB 92 Inzell Dorfrunde! You rode the 18.3 km circular route, gaining 315 m of climbing. You passed the lake Falkensee and the churches St. Barbara and St. Nikolaus, starting near Inzell.

items.title: Fränkischer WasserRadweg - Etappe 7
items.text: You completed the difficult Fränkischer WasserRadweg - Etappe 7, a 56.3 km one-way route near Ansbach. You climbed 471 m and passed the lake Ziegelweiher and the viewpoint Stadtturm. Well done!

items.title: AV-Weg 604
items.text: You completed the moderate AV-Weg 604, a one-way route of 13.7 km with 345 m of climbing. You hiked from near Tegernsee, passing the lake Tegernsee and the Schwarzenbach-Wasserfall. You also saw the Einblick viewpoint.

items.title: Wanderweg 545
items.text: You completed the easy, one-way Wanderweg 545! You hiked 5.6 km from near Osterwarngau, climbing 67 m. Along the way, you passed St. Benno and St. Maria, and took in the Taubenbergturm viewpoint.

items.title: Vita Parcours „Mönchswald“
items.text: You completed the Vita Parcours „Mönchswald“! You tackled 2.0 km with 24 m of climbing on this easy, circular route that started near Oberhöhberg. Well done!

items.title: Kultour im Naturpark Hirschwald
items.text: You completed the difficult Kultour im Naturpark Hirschwald! You cycled the 43.7 km circular route, starting near Ursensollen, and climbed 550 m. You passed the Heimatmuseum Kastl on your journey.

items.title: Freudenbergtour
items.text: You completed the Freudenbergtour, a circular route of 27.6 km near Gärmersdorf. You tackled 370 m of climbing on this moderate route, passing the lake Teufelsweiher. Well done!

items.title: Hauptradroute rr05
items.text: You completed the easy, one-way Hauptradroute rr05! You cycled 8.9 km with 37 m of climbing, starting near Tegernheim. You passed Berterini Kirche and Peterskirchlein.

items.title: Wasserläufer-Route Etappe 6 / Himmelsstürmer-Route Etappe 3
items.text: You completed the very demanding one-way Wasserläufer-Route Etappe 6 / Himmelsstürmer-Route Etappe 3! You covered 11.7 km with 1,077 m of climbing, starting near Füssen. Along the way, you passed the lakes Schwansee and Alpsee, and the Tegelberghaus hut.

items.title: MTB 81 Brander Alm
items.text: You completed MTB 81 Brander Alm, an easy 6.2 km one-way route near Ruhpolding. You tackled 13 m of climbing on your way to the Brander Alm, following the Seetraun. Congratulations on finishing this route!

items.title: MTB 88 Zinnkopf-Runde
items.text: You completed the moderate MTB 88 Zinnkopf-Runde! You rode 4.4 km with 100 m of climbing on this one-way route that started near Hörgering. You passed a viewpoint on your journey.

items.title: MTB 76 Zinnkopf-Umrundung
items.text: You completed the 11.6 km MTB 76 Zinnkopf-Umrundung! You tackled 268 m of climbing on this moderate, one-way route that started near Hörgering. You followed sections along the Weiße Traun and passed a playground on your journey.

items.title: MTB 67 Kloster-Runde
items.text: You completed the 8.0 km MTB 67 Kloster-Runde, a moderate one-way route that started near Hörgering. You conquered 77 m of climbing and rode along the Weiße Traun, passing a playground on your journey.

items.title: Trimm-Dich-Pfad Stadt Friedberg
items.text: You completed the Trimm-Dich-Pfad Stadt Friedberg! You ran the entire 1.9 km circular route, which included 29 m of climbing. Great job on finishing this easy route that started near Bachern.

items.title: Wasserläufer-Route Etappe 7 / Himmelsstürmer-Route Etappe 4
items.text: You completed the difficult Wasserläufer-Route Etappe 7 / Himmelsstürmer-Route Etappe 4! You hiked 17.3 km with 792 m of climbing. This one-way route, starting near Füssen, took you past the beautiful lake Alatsee and offered views from Zweiseenblick and Zugspitzblick.

items.title: Münchner JakobsKirchenWeg - Radroute
items.text: You completed the Münchner JakobsKirchenWeg - Radroute! This very demanding circular cycling route, starting near Pullach im Isartal, covered 108.3 km with 510 m of climbing. You passed the lakes Moosschwaiger Weiher, Langwieder See and Gündinger Loch, and saw Schloss Dachau.

items.title: GeoRadweg Altmühltal Bahnzubringer
items.text: You completed the GeoRadweg Altmühltal Bahnzubringer! This easy, one-way route, starting near Saal an der Donau, covered 6.8 km with 24 m of climbing. You passed the Altmühltor on your journey.

items.title: Panorama Runde
items.text: You completed the moderate Panorama Runde! This 11.2 km one-way route near Marquartstein involved 163 m of climbing. You passed the Weiße Achen and could have stopped at Staudacheralm / Schmiedkaser. Well done!

items.title: Werr'n-Sie-Fit-Pfad
items.text: You completed the Werr'n-Sie-Fit-Pfad! You covered 1.6 km with 24 m of climbing on this easy, one-way route. You started near Oberwerrn and passed a playground along the way.

items.title: Räuber- und Ritter-Tour
items.text: You completed the Räuber- und Ritter-Tour! You cycled 26.7 km on this circular route, gaining 383 m of climbing. This moderate route, starting near Riedenburg, took you past Schloss Hexenagger, Schloss Sandersdorf, and Schloss Schamhaupten.

items.title: Wanderweg Eber 2
items.text: You completed Wanderweg Eber 2, an easy 5.2 km one-way route near Ebersberg. You climbed 51 m on your journey. You passed the lake Klostersee and the viewpoint Aussichtsturm Ludwigshöhe.

items.title: Wanderweg 251
items.text: You completed the difficult Wanderweg 251! You hiked 5.4 km with 1,178 m of climbing, starting near Griesen. You traversed alpine terrain, reaching summits like Hoher Brand and Brandjoch.

items.title: Trimm-Dich-Pfad im Bahnhofswald Emskirchen
items.text: You completed the Trimm-Dich-Pfad im Bahnhofswald Emskirchen! You tackled this easy, circular route, covering 2.4 km with 28 m of climbing. You started near Emskirchen and finished right where you began.

items.title: Wanderweg 466 - Isarwinkel
items.text: You completed Wanderweg 466 - Isarwinkel, a moderate, one-way route near Obergries. You hiked 10.4 km and climbed 783 m. You passed the Kirchsteinhütte, Enzian-Hütte, and Edelweiß-Hütte.

items.title: Zielwanderweg 8
items.text: You completed Zielwanderweg 8! You hiked 4.6 km on this one-way route, gaining 383 m of climbing. You tackled this easy route that started near Engelsdorf and passed the Kreuzhaus.

items.title: MTB 66 Bründlingalm Runde (von Siegsdorf)
items.text: You completed the very demanding circular route, MTB 66 Bründlingalm Runde (von Siegsdorf)! You rode 30.3 km and climbed 954 m. You passed the waterfall Sinterkalk-Rinne and sections ran along the Weiße Achen and Weiße Traun.

items.title: Hallertauer Hopfentour Spange 1
items.text: You completed the Hallertauer Hopfentour Spange 1! You cycled 23.0 km on this one-way route, climbing 320 m. This moderate route, starting near Schaltdorf, took you past Schloss Wildenberg.

items.title: Wanderweg 686a - Bayrische Voralpen
items.text: You completed Wanderweg 686a - Bayrische Voralpen, a moderate, one-way route. You hiked 2.4 km and climbed 259 m, starting near Tegernsee. You reached the highest point at 1,095 m, and passed Berggasthaus Riederstein.

items.title: Meditationsweg beWEGgründe
items.text: You completed the easy, circular Meditationsweg beWEGgründe! You hiked 3.8 km and climbed 72 m near Ebersberg. Along the way, you passed Antoniuskapelle, St. Sebastian, and Kumpfmühlweiher. Well done!

items.title: ADFC Ebersberg Tour 05 - In den Ebersberg Forst
items.text: You completed the easy, one-way route "ADFC Ebersberg Tour 05 - In den Ebersberg Forst"! You cycled 3.1 km with 42 m of climbing. This route, which started near Ebersberg, took you past the lake Klostersee.

items.title: LafDischFit
items.text: You completed LafDischFit, an easy, one-way route near Frohnhofen. You covered 5.8 km and climbed 69 m. Along the way, you passed Petruskirche and St. Johannes der Täufer.

items.title: Schneeflocke 01
items.text: You completed Schneeflocke 01, an easy 1.9 km one-way route with 102 m of climbing. Starting near Anger, you passed Ruine Hohenburg and Palas. Well done on finishing this route!

items.title: Rundwanderweg 11
items.text: You completed Rundwanderweg 11, a moderate 11.4 km circular route near Elisabethszell. You climbed 422 m on your way, passing the Hansl-Hütte. Well done on finishing this route!

items.title: Weiherradweg
items.text: You completed the Weiherradweg! You cycled 4.0 km with 44 m of climbing on this easy, one-way route. You started near Kronstetten and passed the Stockweiher, Hausweiher, and Hofbauerweiher lakes.

items.title: Zenngründer Museumsrunde
items.text: You completed the difficult Zenngründer Museumsrunde! You cycled the 55.9 km one-way route, starting near Wilhelmsgreuth, and climbed 476 m. Along the way, you passed Obernzenner See, Schloß Ickelheim, and Blaues Schloß.

items.title: TeichKulturRunde
items.text: You completed the difficult TeichKulturRunde, a 56.8 km circular route with 430 m of climbing. You cycled near Nainsdorf and passed the lakes Angerweiher, Großer Torweiher, and Schwärzlweiher. You also went past Schloss Weingartsgreuth and Schloss Adelsdorf.

items.title: Bodensee-Königssee-Radweg: Naturpark Ammergauer Alpen & Das Blaue Land
items.text: You completed the difficult Bodensee-Königssee-Radweg: Naturpark Ammergauer Alpen & Das Blaue Land. You cycled 62.4 km with 641 m of climbing on this one-way route that started near Trauchgau. Along the way, you passed Dorfmuseum and Kriegerdenkmal.

items.title: Marktbergel - Oberdachstetten
items.text: You completed the easy one-way route "Marktbergel - Oberdachstetten"! You cycled 3.9 km with 24 m of climbing, reaching 472 m at the highest point. You passed the lake Schafsee on your journey, which started near Anfelden.

items.title: Adelsdorf - Markt Erlbach
items.text: You completed the easy, one-way route from Adelsdorf to Markt Erlbach! You cycled 3.8 km and climbed 68 m, reaching 384 m at the highest point. You passed the Museum Geschichte und Handwerk and a playground.

items.title: Markt Erlbach - Kotzenaurach
items.text: You completed the easy, one-way route "Markt Erlbach - Kotzenaurach"! You cycled 4.1 km and climbed 48 m, starting near Markt Erlbach. You passed a playground and saw the Museum Geschichte und Handwerk.

items.title: Neustadt a.d. Aisch - Diespeck
items.text: You completed the easy, one-way route Neustadt a.d. Aisch - Diespeck! You cycled 3.6 km and climbed 12 m, starting near Diespeck. Along the way, you passed the Bayerisches Landesluftbildzentrum, Bayerisches Landesluftbildarchiv, and BayernLab Neustadt a. d. Aisch.

items.title: Münchsteinach - Mittelsteinach
items.text: You completed the Münchsteinach - Mittelsteinach cycling route! This easy, one-way route covered 3.5 km with 37 m of climbing. You started near Münchsteinach and passed the lake Freizeitsee and the Club-Mate Besuchertribüne.

items.title: Radverkehrsnetz Landkreis Neumarkt i.d. OPf.
items.text: Congratulations! You completed the easy, one-way route, Radverkehrsnetz Landkreis Neumarkt i.d. OPf. You cycled 5.8 km and climbed 42 m. This route started near Oening and passed St. Nikolaus.

items.title: Skulp Tour II
items.text: You completed the Skulp Tour II! You cycled 18.0 km on this easy, one-way route, gaining 62 m of climbing. Starting near Mitterbuch, you passed St. Martin and St. Stephanus. Well done!

items.title: Brünnstein Speed
items.text: You completed the difficult, one-way Brünnstein Speed route! You hiked 15.6 km with 839 m of climbing, starting near Oberaudorf. Along the way, you passed the Gscheier Loch waterfall and Brünnsteinhaus.

items.title: Salzschleife - Wasser-Radlwege Oberbayern - Querverbindung 2
items.text: You completed the Salzschleife - Wasser-Radlwege Oberbayern - Querverbindung 2! You cycled the 27.3 km one-way route, climbing 247 m. You passed by the lakes Seeschneider Weiher and Klostersee, and saw Schloss Falkenberg. This moderate route started near Moosach (Landkreis Ebersberg).

items.title: Goldrush (UrTrails Altmühltal)
items.text: You completed the Goldrush (UrTrails Altmühltal)! This moderate, one-way mountain biking route, starting near Kelheim, covered 8.5 km with 175 m of climbing. You passed the Frauenhäusl and a playground along the way.

items.title: Pure Pleasure (Kurzvariante, UrTrails Altmühltal)
items.text: You completed Pure Pleasure (Kurzvariante, UrTrails Altmühltal), a moderate, 16.1 km one-way mountain biking route. You tackled 373 m of climbing, reaching 509 m at its highest point. Starting near Kelheim, you passed by Frauenhäusl on your journey.

items.title: Pure Pleasure (UrTrails Altmühltal)
items.text: You completed Pure Pleasure (UrTrails Altmühltal)! You tackled this difficult, one-way route, covering 29.3 km with 622 m of climbing. Starting near Kelheim, you passed St. Georg on your journey.

items.title: Nibelungen Ride (UrTrails Altmühltal)
items.text: You completed the Nibelungen Ride (UrTrails Altmühltal)! This difficult, one-way mountain biking route, 26.7 km long with 533 m of climbing, started near Riedenburg. You passed Pestkapelle Maria Hilf Emmerthal and Weihermühlkapelle.

items.title: Trails of Kelheim (UrTrails Altmühltal)
items.text: You completed the Trails of Kelheim (UrTrails Altmühltal)! You rode 5.1 km on this one-way route, starting near Kelheim. You gained 125 m in climbing and reached the summit of Feckinger Berg (494 m) on this moderate route.

items.title: Icecream Deluxe (UrTrails Altmühltal)
items.text: You completed the 11.6 km one-way route, Icecream Deluxe (UrTrails Altmühltal). You conquered 159 m of climbing on this moderate route, which started near Painten. You passed St. Georg on your journey.

items.title: Grenzenlos Wanderweg (Bad Endorf-Prien a. Chiemsee)
items.text: You completed the Grenzenlos Wanderweg (Bad Endorf-Prien a. Chiemsee)! You hiked 15.2 km on this one-way, moderate route, climbing 148 m. You passed the lake Chiemsee and followed the Prien, starting near Bad Endorf. Well done!

items.title: Moosrundweg 3
items.text: You completed the Moosrundweg 3, an easy 4.3 km circular route near Benediktbeuern. You conquered 17 m of climbing, reaching 621 m at the highest point. Along the way, you passed Kloster Benediktbeuern and Zentrum Gebirgsschützen Bayern.
